page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU subsystem is equipped with 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, alongside support for instruction extensions including AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA extensions. It is provisioned with 48 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per vCPU. Network throughput is provisioned with an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage for persistent data requirements.

Benchmark testing places the instance solidly in the median tier across compute, memory, and application-level workloads. The system achieves a single-core stress-ng rating of 1882.39 and a multi-core score of 11625.39, supplemented by Geekbench single-core and multi-core results of 1593.0 and 7907.0, respectively. Memory subsystem throughput reaches 81.59 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 53.67 GB/sec for uncached writes, yielding a PassMark memory score of 2441.06. In synthetic database operations, the instance registers 5907.31 operations, while handling 11.74 million Redis SET operations per second and 16.97 GB/sec of static web serving throughput. Natural language model evaluations reveal average throughput for smaller 135M parameter models, but processing latency increases significantly on medium 7B models, where prompt evaluation drops into the bottom quartile at 23.62 tokens per second.

Cost efficiency is centered around the standard resource density of the balanced compute-to-memory profile. With no integrated disk storage or dedicated GPU silicon, operational efficiency relies entirely on matching CPU-bound and in-memory execution tasks without over-allocating unused specialized hardware. The ecs.g7.3xlarge is appropriate for medium-scale enterprise application tiers, web and API hosting, software compilation pipelines, caching layers, and relational or transactional databases utilizing external block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48 GB of RAM powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Built on KVM virtualization, it includes an 8 Gbps network baseline and vector instruction capabilities including AVX-512 VNNI. The hardware configuration offers no bundled local storage and no GPU accelerators, directing persistent storage to network block volumes. Benchmark testing shows steady mid-tier compute and memory performance, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng score of 11625.39, Geekbench multi-core score of 7907.0, and 11.74 million Redis SET operations per second. While capable of managing lightweight natural language inference, larger model execution shows throughput constraints. The balanced 1:4 core-to-memory allocation makes this server well configured for web serving, microservices architectures, CI/CD compilation, and mid-sized database management.
